                  SEGGER_RTT_WriteSkipNoLock PROC
;;;939    #if (RTT_USE_ASM == 0)
;;;940    unsigned SEGGER_RTT_WriteSkipNoLock(unsigned BufferIndex, const void* pBuffer, unsigned NumBytes) {
000000  e92d41f0          PUSH     {r4-r8,lr}
000004  4688              MOV      r8,r1
000006  4616              MOV      r6,r2
;;;941      const char*           pData;
;;;942      SEGGER_RTT_BUFFER_UP* pRing;
;;;943      unsigned              Avail;
;;;944      unsigned              RdOff;
;;;945      unsigned              WrOff;
;;;946      unsigned              Rem;
;;;947      volatile char*        pDst;
;;;948      //
;;;949      // Cases:
;;;950      //   1) RdOff <= WrOff => Space until wrap-around is sufficient
;;;951      //   2) RdOff <= WrOff => Space after wrap-around needed (copy in 2 chunks)
;;;952      //   3) RdOff <  WrOff => No space in buf
;;;953      //   4) RdOff >  WrOff => Space is sufficient
;;;954      //   5) RdOff >  WrOff => No space in buf
;;;955      //
;;;956      // 1) is the most common case for large buffers and assuming that J-Link reads the data fast enough
;;;957      //
;;;958      pData = (const char *)pBuffer;
;;;959      pRing = (SEGGER_RTT_BUFFER_UP*)((char*)&_SEGGER_RTT.aUp[BufferIndex] + SEGGER_RTT_UNCACHED_OFF);  // Access uncached to make sure we see changes made by the J-Link side and all of our changes go into HW directly
000008  491d              LDR      r1,|L30.128|
00000a  eb000040          ADD      r0,r0,r0,LSL #1
00000e  eb0104c0          ADD      r4,r1,r0,LSL #3
000012  3418              ADDS     r4,r4,#0x18
;;;960      RdOff = pRing->RdOff;
000014  6922              LDR      r2,[r4,#0x10]
;;;961      WrOff = pRing->WrOff;
000016  68e5              LDR      r5,[r4,#0xc]
;;;962      pDst = (pRing->pBuffer + WrOff) + SEGGER_RTT_UNCACHED_OFF;
000018  6860              LDR      r0,[r4,#4]
00001a  4428              ADD      r0,r0,r5
;;;963      if (RdOff <= WrOff) {                                 // Case 1), 2) or 3)
00001c  42aa              CMP      r2,r5
00001e  d820              BHI      |L30.98|
;;;964        Avail = pRing->SizeOfBuffer - WrOff - 1u;           // Space until wrap-around (assume 1 byte not usable for case that RdOff == 0)
000020  68a1              LDR      r1,[r4,#8]
000022  1b49              SUBS     r1,r1,r5
000024  460f              MOV      r7,r1
000026  1e49              SUBS     r1,r1,#1
;;;965        if (Avail >= NumBytes) {                            // Case 1)?
000028  42b1              CMP      r1,r6
00002a  d308              BCC      |L30.62|
;;;966          memcpy((void*)pDst, pData, NumBytes);
00002c  4632              MOV      r2,r6
00002e  4641              MOV      r1,r8
000030  f7fffffe          BL       __aeabi_memcpy
;;;967          RTT__DMB();                     // Force data write to be complete before writing the <WrOff>, in case CPU is allowed to change the order of memory accesses
;;;968          pRing->WrOff = WrOff + NumBytes;
000034  19a8              ADDS     r0,r5,r6
000036  60e0              STR      r0,[r4,#0xc]
